column7: \record StraightJoin {A : \Type} (a : A) (b : A) (rel : A -> A -> \Type) { | common-reduct : A | a~>cr : rel a common-reduct | b~>cr : rel b common-reduct }
\data Closure {A : \Type} (R : A -> A -> \Type) (a b : A) | c-trivial (a = b) | c-basic (a `R` b) | c-connect (c : A) (a `R` c) (Closure R c b)
\func compose {A : \Type} {R : A -> A -> \Type} {a b c : A} (a~>b : Closure R a b) (b~>c : Closure R b c) : Closure R a c

\func lift {A B : \Type} {rel : A -> A -> \Type} {rel' : B -> B -> \Type} (map : A -> B) (rel-map : \Pi {a b : A} (rel a b) -> rel' (map a) (map b)) (x y : A) (closure : Closure rel x y) : Closure rel' (map x) (map y)
\func flatten {A : \Type} {rel : A -> A -> \Type} {x y : A} (closure : Closure (Closure rel) x y) : Closure rel x y
\func extract {A : \Type} {rel : A -> A -> \Type} {x y : A} (closure : Closure rel x y) : Or (x = y) (\Sigma (z : A) (rel x z))
